disclosure: THROWAWAY MOCK. Memberships are COMPUTED (clustering + label propagation in full 14-dim MCA space); island SEATING is DESIGNED-FOR-LEGIBILITY (MDS on cluster centroids + within-island local layout + water by fiat), NOT a measured coordinate. G1/G2/G3 ratification gates NOT run (charter-run, pre-registered, later). Nothing served, nothing vendored.

grain_assert.note: kit-grain-clean by construction; mcd + LA are post-E1 growth

clustering.space: full 14-dim MCA coordinates (dim1..dim14 from E1 CSV) — retained-dims space, NOT the 2D plane
clustering.method: Leiden-CPM consensus on kNN(k=10) graph, 60 seeds @ resolution 0.3
clustering.hdbscan_rejected: HDBSCAN tried on the same space; produced a degenerate giant cluster (65-72% of kits at min_cluster_size 5-10) because the dense MCA core lumps. Rejected. Leiden-CPM partitions the core.

family_labels.method: family = nearest gateA seed by family; core iff ABSOLUTE affinity (MCA-space distance to nearest same-family seed) <= tau; mainland (far from all families) abstains as drifters. Absolute-distance tau (not vote-share) is what makes the mainland/family separation real.

tau_calibration.tau_semantics: absolute distance in MCA space to nearest same-family gateA seed

definitions.core: tau-confident family member (gateA seed OR propagated share>=tau)
definitions.islet: member of an unseeded cluster (no gateA seed, no core) — labeled U-n
definitions.strait: split affinity between two families within margin m=0.15
definitions.drifter: below-tau with no strong family match (dense mainland + scatter)
definitions.ghost: feasible cells shaded by family affinity; shallow=family-adjacent, deep=frontier

ghost_field.method_note: MOCK approximation over the 469 kits' own unclaimed (drifter+islet) footprint; NOT the charter 11,160-cell meso ghost-field projection (that is Edition-scoped + read-only).

seating.method: MDS(2D) on cluster centroids (full-space euclidean) + within-island local MDS layout + water by fiat

tombstones.finding_F1: tombstones seat on their HOME island (kit death is not geography); E1-469 has ZERO negative kits, so F-1 is honored vacuously — mechanism disclosed, no placement needed.
